''LL parser'' is a [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Top-down_parsing top-down parser] for a subset of [[context free grammars|context-free languages]]. It parses the input from <u>L</u>eft to right, performing [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Context-free_grammar#Derivations_and_syntax_trees <u>L</u>eftmost derivation] of the sentence.
